short_def: Something you want to learn or do.
explanation: A learning goal tells you what you will be able to do at the end of the lesson.
example: Our goal today is to use four new words.

explanation: You and a partner help each other. You take turns to talk and listen.
example: Turn to your partner and share your answer.

short_def: To talk about something with other people.
explanation: When you discuss, you share ideas, listen and ask questions.
example: We will discuss the question in groups.

short_def: A short version of the main ideas.
explanation: A summary uses only the most important ideas. It is shorter than the original.
example: Write a one-sentence summary of the lesson.
